name: Serve The Servants

evidence.note: Band site: Long Island Nirvana tribute aiming to copy the Nirvana live show.
Oct 3 'Unplugged' show at The Warehouse, Amityville, with Love Hate Love and Unglued.
Plays grunge tribute festivals alongside Alice in Chains and Pearl Jam tributes.

dancing.notes: A Nirvana tribute is a rock concert where fans watch, sing and sometimes mosh. This weekend's show is billed as Unplugged (acoustic), so expect a listening crowd.

description: Long Island Nirvana tribute trio, active since 2023, that recreates Nirvana's live show; on Oct 3 it plays an 'Unplugged' acoustic night at The Warehouse in Amityville.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Band site lists Oct 3 as 'Unplugged at Katie's / Katies of Smithtown', but AllEvents and Ira's List put the Unplugged show at The Warehouse, Amityville. Owner may want to confirm the venue.
